title: "Are You Sure?": An Empirical Study of Human Perception Vulnerability in LLM-Driven Agentic Systems
reasoning: The paper focuses on human susceptibility to security attacks (Agent-Mediated Deception) in LLM agent systems. While it contains a section on 'Ethical Considerations' related to the conduct of its human participant study, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical reasoning within the LLMs themselves.
